summary: NFSv4 migration lets responsibility for a single file system move from one server to another without disrupting clients. Experience showed problems in how NFSv4.0 specified this. This proposed standard identifies those problem areas and gives revised specifications for them.

eli5.summary: Picture moving a library shelf to a new room while people are still borrowing books, without anyone noticing. This fixes the rules for doing that smoothly when a file server hands its files to another server.

questions: moving a file system between nfs servers
